recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It directly completes the remaining description cleanup for FHIR-39024 in active SubscriptionTopic source while respecting later FHIR-I decisions that broadened event/non-FHIR definitions beyond only concrete resources.
issue_request: FHIR-39024 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for R5 and requested that SubscriptionTopic.resourceTrigger.resource, eventTrigger.resource, canFilterBy.resource, and notificationShape.resource stop referencing all FHIR data types; the resolution directed use of the new cross-version resource-type value set and removal of data-type target wording from descriptions where needed.
initial_application: Commit 23bc6d672392d659a2ad57ef61377032588f7943 explicitly applied FHIR-39024 by changing the four R5 SubscriptionTopic resource bindings to ValueSet/subscription-types with all-resource-types UI additional bindings, but it left Data Type wording in the resourceTrigger.resource and eventTrigger.resource short descriptions. Current R6 source carried that residual wording into SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource and had a similar Data Type phrase in trigger.notificationShape.resource.
additional_context: FHIR-38800 established the version-independent resource-type terminology used by SubscriptionTypes. Later Applied R6 issues FHIR-46492 and FHIR-47365 intentionally merged resource/event triggers and documented non-FHIR subscription approaches, including logical models and Parameters/Binary examples; existing combined-branch reconcile commits already represent those later issues. Therefore the safe current-build fix is to remove data type as a target without narrowing logical-model or other non-FHIR definition support.
reconciliation: Updated source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml so SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource says 'Key resource type or relevant definition' and trigger.notificationShape.resource says 'Resource type or other definition (e.g., logical model)' instead of advertising a Data Type target. The binding and later R6 non-FHIR guidance were intentionally left unchanged.
source_changes: source/subscriptiontopic/structuredefinition-SubscriptionTopic.xml: removed stale Data Type target wording from SubscriptionTopic.trigger.resource short text and SubscriptionTopic.trigger.notificationShape.resource definition.

related_jiras.note: Established the version-independent resource-type terminology and related Subscription/SubscriptionTopic binding changes that FHIR-39024 built on.
Collapsed SubscriptionTopic resourceTrigger/eventTrigger and moved canFilterBy/notificationShape under trigger, carrying the seed's affected paths into current R6 source.
Approved non-FHIR subscription notification guidance and examples, which informed the choice to preserve logical-model/other-definition wording.
